description: This file contains the code-behind for an ASP.NET web page called TheorySet, which is part of an online examination system. It manages course selection, question and exam addition, and navigation within the admin interface.

classes.name: TheorySet
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ASP.NET page, handling page load, button clicks, course selection, question insertion, and exam setup.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, currently commented out logic for session handling.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on selected semester, with options varying by academic year and semester.

methods.name: AddQB_Click
methods.description: Adds a new question to the database for the selected course and updates the question number.

methods.name: setB_Click
methods.description: Creates a new exam entry for the selected course in the database.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course options upon semester selection.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the question number based on the selected course.
